verdict.rationale: Pinecone documents a versioned public REST API covering data plane, control plane, inference, admin and OAuth. Machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 specs are published in the official pinecone-io/pinecone-api repo, and a formal versioning policy guarantees at least 12 months of support per stable version. The 404s at the probed docs-domain OpenAPI paths only reflect where the specs are hosted, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: an interactive in-page API runner (the docs playground is disabled) and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the API end to end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: listing dated machine-readable specs for every API surface (data plane, control plane, inference, admin, oauth), hosted in the official pinecone-io/pinecone-api repository
